title: A Restaurant Review
text:
Mark wrote a review of a new Italian restaurant in town. He said the pizza was very good, but the service was slow. The waiter was friendly and the room was clean. Mark gave the restaurant four stars out of five.

Lisa read his review before she went to the restaurant. She wanted to try the pasta, because Mark said it was delicious. She went there on Friday and agreed with him. She wrote a review too, and she also gave it four stars.

questions.text: How many stars did Mark give the restaurant?
What did Lisa want to try at the restaurant?
Why did Lisa read Mark's review before she went to the restaurant?
options: She wanted to know if the restaurant was good
She wanted to write a book
She wanted to work at the restaurant
She wanted to buy a new car

questions.text: How did Mark probably feel about the restaurant overall?
options: He liked it, but not perfectly
He was angry about the pizza

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a place, product, or service
a place where you pay to eat a meal
the help that staff give to customers

paragraph_translations: Mark napisał recenzję nowej włoskiej restauracji w mieście. Powiedział, że pizza była bardzo dobra, ale obsługa była wolna. Kelner był miły, a sala była czysta. Mark dał restauracji cztery gwiazdki na pięć.

Lisa przeczytała jego recenzję, zanim poszła do restauracji. Chciała spróbować makaronu, bo Mark powiedział, że był pyszny. Poszła tam w piątek i zgodziła się z nim. Ona też napisała recenzję i dała jej cztery gwiazdki.
